thread.title: With iPhone Growth Slowing, What Are Apple's Potential Growth Areas?

author: Nelson Wang
title: With iPhone Growth Slowing, What Are Apple's Potential Growth Areas?
text:
As Apple's ( AAPL ) latest surprise sales warning made clear, iPhone sales aren't going to power its growth forever.
The tech giant has already prioritized its Services businesses to leverage its massive installed base of users, but sooner or later, Apple will need to find major new markets to create and conquer.
What could those be? TheStreet's tech columnist Eric Jhonsa and Zev Fima of the Action Alerts Plus portfolio , which owns Apple, discuss the projects that Apple could be focusing on next, the reasons for the revenue miss and the near- and long-term outlook for Apple's stock.
